scope: All 102 native-SR=0 episodes from the completed baseline200; paired oracle outcome used only after classification.
evidence: only first two model RGB frames, not full trajectory video
classification: Mutually exclusive primary failure category plus secondary termination/outcome tags; chronological route evidence required; distance threshold alone is not semantic branch error. Goal passing and physical failures treated separately when supported; uncertain cases retained.
confidence_definition: high/moderate are qualitative evidence-strength judgments by one reviewer, not calibrated probabilities or inter-rater agreement.
